dedupe_keys.name: reproducibility package for uncertainty aware decision support for e waste management under data scarcity cross country machine learning and evidence bounded resource recovery in iraq

description: Mustafa Wassef Hasan publishes a reproducibility package for uncertainty-aware electronic-waste planning in Iraq. Zenodo serves a public ZIP under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. The own page describes derived analytical outputs, machine-readable supplementary tables, quality-control reports, selected analysis scripts and provenance. Its predictive layer estimates electrical and electronic equipment placed on the market from cross-country data, while a separate accounting layer anchors an Iraqi 2022 e-waste quantity to the official 267 kt report. A modeller can use the tables to compare waste-processing or resource-recovery scenarios under data scarcity. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this package. A limitation is that third-party input datasets are not redistributed, and equipment placed on the market is not same-year waste generation. Some pipeline stages were not rerun for this release. The ZIP was not downloaded, so tables, uncertainty intervals and code outputs were not independently checked.
